# Rubi command reference

<!-- Generated by `npm run guide` from data/commands. Don't edit by hand: change the command, then regenerate. -->

Every command, with the same information as `/help <command>` in the chat. New here? Start with the [user guide](using-rubi.md); group admins, see the [admin guide](group-admins.md).

**Reading the usage line:** `<name>` is required, `[name]` is optional, `name...` takes the rest of the message, and `a|b` means one of those words. Members can be given as an @mention, a name (`@'Jo Do'` with spaces) or `#id` (see `/members`). Numbers may use commas (`1,000`).

**Cooldown** is how long one person waits before using the same command again (default 2 s). Bot admins skip cooldowns.

- 📖 **General**: [`/about`](#cmd-about) [`/help`](#cmd-help) [`/invite`](#cmd-invite) [`/ping`](#cmd-ping) [`/whoami`](#cmd-whoami)

<a id="cmd-help"></a>
### `/help`

List commands, or show details for one

/help lists categories and commands; /help <category> adds descriptions; /help <command> shows everything about one command.

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/help [command]` |
| Where | DMs and groups |
| Who | Everyone |
| Cooldown | 2 s |
| Aliases | `/h`, `/commands`, `/start` |

**Arguments**

- `command` (optional, word or "quoted text"): A command or category to show details for

**Examples**

- `/help`
- `/help utility`
- `/help remind`

## 🛠 Utility

Handy tools.

<a id="cmd-base64"></a>
### `/base64`

Encode or decode Base64

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/base64 <encode\|decode> <text...>` |
| Where | DMs and groups |
| Who | Everyone |
| Cooldown | 2 s |
| Aliases | `/b64` |

**Arguments**

- `action` (required, one of `encode`, `decode`): encode or decode
- `text` (required, text): The text

**Examples**

- `/base64 encode hello`
- `/base64 decode aGVsbG8=`

|---|---|
| Usage | `/calc <expression...>` |
| Where | DMs and groups |
| Who | Everyone |
| Cooldown | 2 s |
| Aliases | `/math`, `/calculate` |

**Arguments**

- `expression` (required, text): What to calculate

**Examples**

- `/calc 2+2`
- `/calc sqrt(2)*10`
- `/calc 15% * 80`

<a id="cmd-cleanlink"></a>
### `/cleanlink`

Remove common tracking parameters from a URL

Works offline and never opens the URL. Signed or tokenized URLs are left unchanged rather than risking a broken link.

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/cleanlink [url...]` |
| Where | DMs and groups |
| Who | Everyone |
| Cooldown | 2 s |
| Aliases | `/cleanurl` |

**Arguments**

- `url` (optional, text): HTTP(S) URL

**Examples**

- `/cleanlink https://example.org/?utm_source=newsletter&id=7`

<a id="cmd-convert"></a>
### `/convert`

Convert units offline: /convert 1,000 m ft

Length, mass, temperature, area, volume, speed, time, data, energy, power, pressure and angle. Use symbols or full names; add 'to' if you like. /convert units shows the categories and common units.

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/convert <query...>` |
| Where | DMs and groups |
| Who | Everyone |
| Cooldown | 2 s |

**Arguments**

- `query` (required, text): <amount> <from> [to] <to>, or units

**Examples**

- `/convert 1,000 m ft`
- `/convert 32 F to C`
- `/convert 2 cups mL`
- `/convert units`

Hash text: /hash sha256 hello

<a id="cmd-password"></a>
### `/password`

Generate a strong random password (DMs only)

Generated with a cryptographic RNG and not stored by Rubi separately. It remains in SimpleX chat history until you delete the message. Look-alike characters (0/O, 1/l/I) are left out. DMs only, so it isn't shown to a whole group.

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/password [length] [strong\|alnum\|pin]` |
| Where | Direct messages only |
| Who | Everyone |
| Cooldown | 1 s |
| Aliases | `/pass`, `/pw` |

**Arguments**

- `length` (optional, whole number, 4–128): Length (4–128, default 20)
- `kind` (optional, one of `strong`, `alnum`, `pin`): strong (default), alnum or pin

**Examples**

- `/password`
- `/password 32`
- `/password 6 pin`

<a id="cmd-poll"></a>
### `/poll`

Start a poll: /poll Pizza tonight? | yes | no | maybe

Separate the question and options with |. With no options it's a 👍/👎 poll. Up to 8 options. Vote by reacting with an option's emoji (I add the reactions myself for polls with up to 3 options — they don't count as votes), or tap its vote button in DMs. One vote per person; only its creator can close it with /endpoll.

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/poll <poll...>` |
| Where | DMs and groups |
| Who | Everyone |
| Cooldown | 15 s |

**Arguments**

- `poll` (required, text): Question | option | option

**Examples**

- `/poll Movie night? | Friday | Saturday | Sunday`
- `/poll Should we start a book club?`

<a id="cmd-prefs"></a>
### `/prefs`

View or set your personal command defaults

Defaults are used only in direct chats when a command omits a place, country or currency. Explicit arguments always win.

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/prefs [action] [value...]` |
| Where | Direct messages only |
| Who | Everyone |
| Cooldown | 2 s |

**Arguments**

- `action` (optional, word or "quoted text"): set, reset or list
- `value` (optional, text): Preference and value

**Examples**

- `/prefs`
- `/prefs set weather Oslo`
- `/prefs reset currency`

<a id="cmd-remind"></a>
### `/remind`

Set a reminder: /remind 10m stretch

When: a duration (30s, 10m, 1h30m, 2d, 1w), a clock time (18:30, 6pm, tomorrow 9:00) or a date (dec 24 18:00, 24 december, 2026-12-24 8am, friday 9:00; without a time it's 9:00). Clock times use your time zone from /time set (DMs), otherwise the server's. Repeat with every: every 2h (an hour at least), every day 9:00, every monday 18:00. In groups, start with @member to remind someone else (only you can cancel it). Reminders survive restarts.

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/remind <what...>` |
| Where | DMs and groups |
| Who | Everyone |
| Cooldown | 2 s |
| Aliases | `/remindme`, `/reminder` |

**Arguments**

- `what` (required, text): When, then what to remind you about

**Examples**

- `/remind 10m stretch`
- `/remind 1h30m check the oven`
- `/remind tomorrow 9:00 call mom`
- `/remind dec 24 18:00 wrap presents`
- `/remind every day 9:00 standup`
- `/remind @bob 1h check the PR`

<a id="cmd-time"></a>
### `/time`

Current time anywhere: /time Tokyo

Give a city or an IANA zone (Europe/Berlin). In a DM, /time set <place> saves your zone — then /time shows it and /remind uses it for clock times.

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/time [place...]` |
| Where | DMs and groups |
| Who | Everyone |
| Cooldown | 2 s |
| Aliases | `/clock`, `/tz` |

**Arguments**

- `place` (optional, text): City, country or time zone — or: set <place>

**Examples**

- `/time Tokyo`
- `/time Europe/Berlin`
- `/time set London`

<a id="cmd-timestamp"></a>
### `/timestamp`

Convert Unix timestamps and dates

No argument: the current time. A number: Unix seconds (or milliseconds if it's 13+ digits). Anything else: parsed as a date (ISO 8601 works best).

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/timestamp [value...]` |
| Where | DMs and groups |
| Who | Everyone |
| Cooldown | 2 s |
| Aliases | `/ts`, `/epoch`, `/unix` |

**Arguments**

- `value` (optional, text): Unix time or a date

**Examples**

- `/timestamp`
- `/timestamp 1700000000`
- `/timestamp 2030-01-01T00:00:00Z`

<a id="cmd-todo"></a>
### `/todo`

Use add, list, claim, done and remove. Tasks are stored in this chat; creators and assignees control completion.

| Usage | `/todo [action] [value...]` |
| Where | DMs and groups |
| Who | Everyone |
| Cooldown | 2 s |

**Arguments**

- `action` (optional, word or "quoted text"): add, list, claim, done or remove
- `value` (optional, text): Task id or text

**Examples**

- `/todo add bring projector`
- `/todo list`
- `/todo claim abc123`
- `/todo done abc123`

<a id="cmd-reddit"></a>
### `/reddit`

Show a Reddit post: /reddit <link>

Shows the post's title, text, score and upvote ratio, and attaches its images, GIFs, videos and files. Reply to a message containing a Reddit link with just /reddit or /r to show that post. Append - to the link, or reply with /reddit -, to report its media without downloading or attaching it. Works with post links, share links (reddit.com/r/…/s/…), redd.it links and post ids. Posts come from the Arctic Shift archive, so brand-new posts can take a few minutes to appear, and scores are refreshed about 36 hours after posting. Media of NSFW posts is only sent in DMs.

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/reddit [link...]` |
| Where | DMs and groups |
| Who | Everyone |
| Cooldown | 10 s |
| Aliases | `/r` |
| Live reply | yes: a placeholder appears right away and turns into the answer |

**Arguments**

- `link` (optional, text): Post link, share link or post id (or reply to a link)

**Examples**

- `/reddit https://www.reddit.com/r/running/comments/17snc7d/`
- `/r https://www.reddit.com/r/running/s/3TzXiyxaMD`

<a id="cmd-x"></a>
### `/x`

Show a post from X (Twitter): /x <link>

Shows the post's author, text, replies/reposts/likes/views, polls, community notes and quoted posts, and attaches its photos, videos and GIFs (including the quoted post's). Reply to a message containing an X link with just /x to show that post. Append - to the link, or reply with /x -, to report its media without downloading or attaching it. Posts are fetched through the FxTwitter API. Media of sensitive posts is only sent in DMs.

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/x [link...]` |
| Where | DMs and groups |
| Who | Everyone |
| Cooldown | 5 s |
| Aliases | `/twitter`, `/tweet` |
| Live reply | yes: a placeholder appears right away and turns into the answer |

**Arguments**

- `link` (optional, text): x.com or twitter.com post link (or reply to a link)

**Examples**

- `/x https://x.com/jack/status/20`

## 👥 Groups

Group features.

<a id="cmd-afk"></a>
### `/afk`

Mark yourself as away: /afk lunch

While you're away, I tell people who @mention you. It ends as soon as you post again.

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/afk [reason...]` |
| Where | Groups only |
| Who | Everyone |
| Cooldown | 2 s |
| Aliases | `/away`, `/brb` |

**Arguments**

- `reason` (optional, text): Why you're away

**Examples**

- `/afk`
- `/afk lunch, back at 2`

<a id="cmd-antispam"></a>
### `/antispam`

Delete links from brand-new members (admins)

When on, links posted by members who joined less than 24 hours ago (and are below moderator) are deleted. I need to be a moderator or higher.

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/antispam [state]` |
| Where | Groups only |
| Who | Group admins |
| Cooldown | 2 s |

**Arguments**

- `state` (optional, yes/no): on or off

**Examples**

- `/antispam on`
- `/antispam off`

<a id="cmd-event"></a>
### `/event`

Create and RSVP to a group event

Create one-off events with a timezone and visible yes/maybe/no RSVPs.

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/event [action] [value...]` |
| Where | Groups only |
| Who | Everyone |
| Cooldown | 2 s |

**Arguments**

- `action` (optional, word or "quoted text"): new, list, rsvp or cancel
- `value` (optional, text): Event details or id/status

**Examples**

- `/event new tomorrow 18:30 | Europe/London | Book club`
- `/event list`
- `/event rsvp abc123 yes`

<a id="cmd-filter"></a>
### `/filter`

Delete messages with banned words (admins)

add/remove take words or phrases separated by commas; * matches the rest of a word (crypto* also blocks cryptocoin), and remove also takes * patterns. action: what else happens to the author (delete only, warn = a /warn, block = a timed /block, default 10m). level: normal, strict or max (send /filter level to compare them). The word list is only ever sent to you by DM (link your DMs with /modlog on). Moderators and admins aren't filtered, edits are checked too, and I need to be a moderator or higher.

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/filter [add\|remove\|list\|clear\|action\|level] [words...]` |
| Where | Groups only |
| Who | Group admins |
| Cooldown | 2 s |
| Aliases | `/bannedwords` |

**Arguments**

- `action` (optional, one of `add`, `remove`, `list`, `clear`, `action`, `level`): add, remove, list, clear, action or level
- `words` (optional, text): Words or phrases (comma-separated), or the setting

**Examples**

- `/filter add spam, buy now, crypto*`
- `/filter remove crypto*`
- `/filter action block 1h`
- `/filter level strict`
- `/filter list`

|---|---|

- `/groupmenu off`

|---|---|

| Where | Groups only |
| Who | Everyone |
| Cooldown | 2 s |

When a member last posted: /seen @bob

<a id="cmd-slowmode"></a>
### `/slowmode`

Limit how often members can post (admins)

Members below moderator can send one message per interval; faster messages are deleted. Commands don't count. Interval: 5s to 6h. /slowmode off turns it off. I need to be a moderator or higher.

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/slowmode [interval...]` |
| Where | Groups only |
| Who | Group admins |
| Cooldown | 2 s |

**Arguments**

- `interval` (optional, text): e.g. 30s, 2m, or off

**Examples**

- `/slowmode 30s`
- `/slowmode off`

<a id="cmd-toggle"></a>
### `/toggle`

Turn commands on or off in this group (admins)

Name commands or whole categories, separated by commas or spaces: /toggle off fun turns off every Fun command. Turned-off commands don't run here (for anyone, admins included), disappear from /help and from the group's / menu. /help and /toggle can't be turned off. /toggle alone lists what's off.

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/toggle [on\|off] [commands...]` |
| Where | Groups only |
| Who | Group admins |
| Cooldown | 2 s |

**Arguments**

- `state` (optional, one of `on`, `off`): on or off
- `commands` (optional, text): Commands or categories

**Examples**

- `/toggle off fun`
- `/toggle off trivia, joke`
- `/toggle on trivia`
- `/toggle`

Greet new members (admins: /welcome set Hi {name}!)

{name} becomes an @mention of the new member and {group} the group name. /welcome off disables it, /welcome test previews it.

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/welcome [set\|off\|test] [text...]` |
| Where | Groups only |
| Who | Group admins |
| Cooldown | 2 s |

**Examples**

- `/welcome test`
- `/welcome off`

## 🛡 Moderation

Keep groups tidy (moderators/admins).

<a id="cmd-block"></a>
### `/block`

Block a member for everyone (their messages are hidden)

Blocked members stay in the group but nobody sees their new messages. Add a duration (10m, 2h, 1d; up to 30 days) to unblock them automatically. Undo with /unblock.

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/block <member> [duration...]` |
| Where | Groups only |
| Who | Group moderators |
| Rubi must be | group moderator (or higher) |
| Cooldown | 2 s |
| Aliases | `/mute` |

**Arguments**

- `member` (required, group member (@mention or name)): Who to block
- `duration` (optional, text): How long (default: until /unblock)

**Examples**

- `/block @troll`
- `/block @troll 10m`

<a id="cmd-delete"></a>
### `/delete`

Reply to a message with /delete to remove it for everyone

Works on members' messages (moderators) and on my own messages. The /delete message is removed too.

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/delete` |
| Where | Groups only |
| Who | Group moderators |
| Rubi must be | group moderator (or higher) |
| Cooldown | none |
| Aliases | `/del`, `/rm` |

<a id="cmd-kick"></a>
### `/kick`

Remove a member from the group

Asks for confirmation first. Their earlier messages stay — remove single ones by replying to them with /delete.

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/kick <member> [reason...]` |
| Where | Groups only |
| Who | Group admins |
| Rubi must be | group admin (or higher) |
| Cooldown | 3 s |
| Aliases | `/remove` |

**Arguments**

- `member` (required, group member (@mention or name)): Who to remove
- `reason` (optional, text): Why (shown in the group)

**Examples**

- `/kick @spammer advertising`

<a id="cmd-modlog"></a>
### `/modlog`

Get the group's moderation log by DM (admins)

In a group, /modlog on sends you every moderation action (kicks, blocks, warnings, deleted and filtered messages, setting changes) by DM, and /modlog off stops it. Nothing sensitive is posted in the group. If I can't reach you yet, I send you a contact request in the group. To use another profile (e.g. not the incognito one you joined with), send /modlog link to me in a DM from that profile, then /modlog on <code> in the group.

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/modlog [on\|off\|link] [code]` |
| Where | DMs and groups |
| Who | Everyone |
| Cooldown | 5 s |

**Arguments**

- `action` (optional, one of `on`, `off`, `link`): on, off or link
- `code` (optional, word or "quoted text"): Code from /modlog link

**Examples**

- `/modlog on`
- `/modlog off`
- `/modlog link`
- `/modlog on 4f7a2c`

<a id="cmd-purge"></a>
### `/purge`

Delete the last messages: /purge 10

Removes the newest messages for everyone (up to 50), after you confirm. Add a member to only remove theirs. Messages from members whose role is equal to or higher than yours or mine are left alone.

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/purge <count> [member]` |
| Where | Groups only |
| Who | Group moderators |
| Rubi must be | group moderator (or higher) |
| Cooldown | 10 s |

**Arguments**

- `count` (required, whole number, 1–50): How many messages (1–50)
- `member` (optional, group member (@mention or name)): Only this member's messages

**Examples**

- `/purge 10`
- `/purge 20 @spammer`

<a id="cmd-role"></a>
### `/role`

Change a member's role

You can't give a role higher than your own. I need a role at least as high as both the old and the new one.

| | |
|---|---|
| Usage | `/role <member> <observer\|author\|member\|moderator\|admin\|owner>` |
| Where | Groups only |
| Who | Group admins |
| Rubi must be | group admin (or higher) |
| Cooldown | 2 s |
| Aliases | `/setrole`, `/promote` |

**Arguments**

- `member` (required, group member (@mention or name)): Whose role to change
- `role` (required, one of `observer`, `author`, `member`, `moderator`, `admin`, `owner`): New role

**Examples**

- `/role @alice moderator`
- `/role @bob observer`

Unblock a member

|---|---|
